# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 25 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth Makes the Tablets

---

**25:1** Seth did as his mother Eve commanded and made tablets of stone and of clay, writing on them all the deeds of his father and mother.

**25:2** Seth was a righteous man who feared God all his days and walked in all the ways of his father Adam.

**25:3** After Eve's death, Seth lived on and continued to multiply and fill the earth.

**25:4** Seth lived nine hundred and twelve years.

---
